verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Honeycomb accepts OTLP directly over gRPC, HTTP/protobuf, and HTTP/JSON for traces, logs, and metrics. They also document extending OTel auto-instrumentation and creating metrics with OTel SDKs, and they point users off the legacy Beelines and onto OpenTelemetry SDKs, which signals first-class support. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of OTLP ingestion.
